author: Glantz, David M.
title: The Soviet-German War 1941-1945: Myths and Realities - A Survey Essay
publisher: Strom Thurmond Institute of Government and Public Affairs, Clemson University, South Carolina
notes: The 20th Anniversary Distinguished Lecture at Clemson, 11 October 2001, by the leading Western specialist on the Soviet-German war, and freely available. Read here for the opening of the war only - the essay's own pagination is used. It is a survey of what the Soviet archives had by then changed about the Western picture of the Eastern Front, and it is cited in this pack for one thing: the date and scale of 22 June 1941, so that the causal chain out of the civil war has something real to end at.
